eta_shape.official_basis: PTX M64,group1,non-ws uses half datapath; exact 0.5 throughput is inference

gamma_smem.requirement: Source layout analysis or explicitly labeled sensitivity

formulas.dense_mma_flops: 2*M*N*K per issued full CTA/CTA-pair/warp tile; include executed padding
formulas.scalar_service: ceil(scalar_results/R_scalar); FMA counts as one result
formulas.pipeline_cycles: W+(n-1)*I+D; use source graph for short pipelines
formulas.simple_inflight_latency_bound: I>=L/k for a stated simple periodic stream with k usable slots
formulas.k1_cohort_phase_if_overlap_permitted: max_r ceil(k*d_phase_r/R_r); source-sequential resource nodes must instead be summed in graph order
formulas.k1_event_schedule: Admit <=b CTAs per SM; schedule replicated ready nodes against shared SM resources and the one global HBM resource; release residency only at source exit

accounting_policy.cta_pair_work: attribute each SM its work; full instruction counted once globally
accounting_policy.warp_mma_work: one logical warp-collective instruction represents full tile; no x32
accounting_policy.rounding: source nodes/batches, not each scalar operation
accounting_policy.overlap: only where source dependencies and reuse ordering permit

allowed_evidence: ptxas or static cubin register/shared-memory allocation
residency_policy.missing_compiler_metadata: report b_resource_upper and bracket b, not actual residency
residency_policy.tmem_cap: do not assert physical SM column cap from per-CTA address view

freeze_policy: Lead records model ID/constants, source counts/dependency graph, traffic scenario, residency bracket and scheduling policy before timing evidence. Later revisions preserve old model and disclose independent reason.
